item.description: Six launch pads in both hemispheres provides our customers with the means to reach space from multiple points on Earth, just hours apart. We started with the world's first private orbital launch site on the Mahia Peninsula in New Zealand, followed with two launch sites in the United States, and have begun ground works for more sites in Alaska. Breaking bottlenecks with regular, reliable and responsive launch for orbital and suborbital missions - one Launch Complex at a time.
